dynamo.placementHint: Join it to a drive shaft or any turning part of a workshop line.

steam_engine.placementHint: Goes on top of a furnace, with water against one of its sides.

water_wheel.placementHint: Needs water on at least two of its six sides.

wind_turbine.placementHint: Needs open sky above. Higher is better.

fission_pile.placementHint: Needs water on at least two of its six sides.

berry_bush.placementHint: Plant on grass, dirt or peat.

pump.placementHint: Must touch still water, lava or oil.

boiler.placementHint: Goes directly on top of a furnace or a hearth. Pipe its steam out through a hot pipe, and set the pipe end at the boiler to Pull with the wrench.

steam_turbine.placementHint: Pipe steam in from a boiler through a hot pipe, and set the pipe end at the boiler to Pull with the wrench.

item_hatch.placementHint: Build it into a face of a hearth wall.

fluid_hatch.placementHint: Build it into a face of a hearth wall.

power_port.placementHint: Build it into a face of a hearth wall.

tea_bush.placementHint: Plant on grass, dirt, peat or farmland.

coffee_shrub.placementHint: Plant on grass, dirt, peat or farmland.

kettle.placementHint: Stands on top of a furnace.

boiler_vessel.placementHint: Set it in the wall of a closed boiler of plates.
